about: Runs of all.html's run all benchmarks: ms per step, every round, by workload and generator. Recorded by the agent Nov 3, 2026, on the user's MacBook Pro (M1 Pro), test suites paused, Chrome headless and Firefox in a window. The two iPhone 15 runs (Safari 27.0.1, Nov 3) were the user's, on the phone, served from the laptop over Tailscale by tools/collect.py. The four Linux runs (NVIDIA RTX 4060; Firefox 160 and Chrome 157, two each, Nov 11) were the user's, on that machine.
